Membership is a subscription service that allows you to enjoy various perks by paying a monthly fee.
Memberships are available for each holomem, and the perks vary for each.

▼Perks While Valid
・Sign-Up Bonus Sticker
・Sign-Up Bonus Title
・Official Fan Badge
*Perks vary for each holomem.
*Cannot be used after validity period.

▼Sign-Up/Renewal Perks
▽First Membership Subscription
・Corresponding holomem Menshi Medals x 6 (3 are first-time join bonuses)

▽Second Subscription Onward
・Corresponding holomem Menshi Medals x 3

▽Renewal
・Corresponding holomem Menshi Medals x 3

*Gifted after logging in upon purchasing or renewing.
*Menshi Medals can be exchanged for items while subscribed.
*Bonuses that were exchanged with Menshi Medals can be used after canceling subscription.

▼Subscription Period & Automatic Renewal
Membership is valid for one month from the day of purchase/renewal.
Unless automatic renewal is canceled, the subscription will renew automatically every month, and the validity period will be extended by one month each time.
The renewal date can be checked after in [Shop]→[Membership].
The renewal time is based on the in-game date reset time.
*In-game date changes every day at 5:00 (JST).
*Please note, depending on when the subscription began or renewed—such as around the start/end of the month—there may be a delay on the platform side, which could result in your subscription period being shifted by a number of days.
・If you wish to cancel your membership, please complete the cancellation process at least 72 hours before the automatic renewal.
*If more than 72 hours before the automatic renewal have already passed, there may be a delay in the platform’s processing time, and the next renewal may still occur.
・Even if subscription is canceled during the valid period, you can continue to use the Membership services until the end of the valid period.

▼Cancel Membership
You can cancel your subscription by following the steps below.

[iOS Devices]
1. Select your Player Name from [Settings].
2. Select [Subscription].
3. Select [hololive Dreams] subscription.
4. Select [Cancel Subscription] to unsubscribe.

[Android Devices]
1. Select Player Icon in Google Play Store.
2. Select [Payments & subscriptions].
3. Select [Subscriptions].
4. Select [hololive Dreams].
5. Select [Cancel Subscription].

*Please note that deleting the app or save data will not cancel your subscription. Please be careful.
*If you have any concerns about the procedure, please contact your platform provider.

▼Important Notes
・Every holomem membership costs ¥290 per month. If you continue your subscription for one year, the total cost will be ¥3,480 for 12 months, including the first month.
*The prices shown above are in Japanese yen (JPY). Please check the confirmation screen for the actual amount to be charged.
・The subscription will be applied to game data you are using when signing up.
*If you subscribe on a device that is not currently being used to play the game, please link your account before subscribing and then log in using the game data you wish to use with your subscription.
・Subscriptions cannot be canceled or refunded after purchase. If you cancel your subscription during the subscription period, you may continue to use the service until the end of the subscription term. No refunds will be provided for any unused portion of the subscription period.
・Account linking ensures that subscribing on multiple devices will not result in duplicate benefits.
・You may experience issues when subscribing. Please do not interrupt the app while the subscription process is in progress.
・If benefits are not reflected in game after subscribing/renewing, please follow the steps below.
In the “hololive Dreams” app, go to [Menu] → [Shop] → [Membership], please select [+] and the [Complete Purhcase] button.
・Under 20 players with still be under a spending limit, even if subscribed.
*This only affects the Japanese version.
・You cannot subscribe via the Steam version. Membership perks earned on the iOS・Android versions can be used on the Steam version.
